equity_bridge.item: Redeemable non-controlling interest (mezzanine equity, Sep 30 2026 balance sheet; new vs Dec 31 2025)
equity_bridge.note: Senior claim on consolidated equity not yet material to flows (see nci_treatment); deducted here rather than via an ongoing NCI leakage rate.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: fy2026_guidance_implied_revenue_growth (not a historical CAGR -- see growth_divergence_warning)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR is negative (-6.3% 3yr / -2.5% 5yr) because book value has been consumed by six years of losses, not because the business is shrinking; revenue CAGR over the same windows is +41.9%/+67.4%, a >100pp divergence. Neither anchors the forward path: revenue CAGR is a scale-up-phase artifact already decelerating sharply (FY2025 +87.7% YoY -> FY2026 guidance-implied +14.9%), and equity CAGR reflects accumulated losses, not operating momentum. EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are not computable at all: EPS has been negative in every year FY2018-FY2025 so no CAGR is defined on a narrowing loss, and owner FCF flips sign from negative in every year FY2018-FY2024 to positive for the first time in FY2025 (RMB3,375.1m) -- a CAGR across a sign change is meaningless. The forward growth path is anchored instead to FY2026 Q4 guidance and the observed 2026 quarterly operating-margin trajectory (component build, section 2).

valuation_philosophy.summary: XPeng is valued as an operating company whose owner FCF turned positive for the first time in FY2025 (RMB3,375.1m after stripping SBC and interest income) after a six-year scale-up funded substantially by external capital (the 2023 Volkswagen and DiDi investments), with the market pricing largely on growth and 'Physical AI' optionality narrative rather than current cash generation. The house case runs a 10-year explicit build until EBITDA margin matures near 10%, because capitalizing a still-thin, recently-inflected margin via Gordon growth on a 5-year horizon would badly understate the business. The path is anchored to Q4 2026 guidance and the operating-margin trajectory already compounding quarter to quarter in 2026, not to the historical revenue or equity CAGRs, both of which are artifacts of the scale-up/loss-accumulation phase rather than a repeatable rate (see historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning).
key_risks_to_valuation: China EV price war compressing gross/vehicle margin further than modelled
Execution risk on new-model ramps (the August 2026 guidance cut)
Customer concentration in Volkswagen technology-licensing revenue
US-China HFCAA/delisting risk and tariffs on Chinese-made EVs undercutting the overseas-expansion thesis
Robotaxi/robotics optionality remaining pre-commercial for years, consuming rather than generating cash
Further dilutive capital raises if the FY2025-26 inflection toward breakeven reverses (not modelled in the flat share count)

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 8.94-22.23 USD
data_sources.financials: research/XPEV/Reports/XPEV_Metrics.csv; XPEV_20F_FY2025.txt and XPEV_6K_Q3-2026.txt (balance sheet, cash composition, operating-expense detail, share count)

realisation_haircut.basis: seeded from the screener PRC markdown, 2026-11-19

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: 1,911,658,601 ordinary shares issued and outstanding as of March 31, 2026 (1,562,950,344 Class A + 348,708,257 Class B; 20-F FY2025 Item 7) plus 52,893,817 Class A RSUs outstanding at the same date = 1,964,552,418 ordinary shares, / 2 ordinary shares per ADS = 982.276M ADS-equivalent. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). The Q3 2026 weighted-average count used for EPS (1,914.47M ordinary / 957.23M ADS) is lower because it is a trailing weighted average and because RSUs are excluded as anti-dilutive during a loss period -- not the right divisor once the model reaches profitability.
inputs.cash_composition: Sep 30 2026 6-K balance sheet (RMB thousands /1000): cash and cash equivalents 19,240.708 + restricted cash 7,251.420 + short-term deposits 4,673.762 + restricted short-term deposits 824.197 + short-term investments 3,012.696 + long-term deposits, current portion 5,932.175 + restricted long-term deposits, current portion 580.865 + long-term deposits (non-current) 2,976.669 + restricted long-term deposits (non-current) 912.876 = RMB45,405.368m, which ties to management's own disclosed 'cash position' of RMB45.41bn as of Sep 30 2026 (the press release's own composition note lists the same line items). total_debt is short-term borrowings 10,681.285 + long-term borrowings current portion 1,683.452 + long-term borrowings non-current 8,364.951 = 20,729.688, excluding lease liabilities (see lease_treatment). Using the narrow 'cash and cash equivalents' line alone (19,240.708) would understate net cash by ~26bn and wrongly show the company net-debt.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F cash-flow-statement SBC add-back, RMB564.3 million (the 20-F's SBC-expense footnote cites the same RMB550.5m/473.7m/564.3m series for 2023/2024/2025, so this is already the company's single combined figure). No separate cash tax withheld on net-share settlement of equity awards is disclosed -- RSUs are the sole award type and no such line appears in financing activities.
inputs.buyback_note: XPeng has adopted no share repurchase program (20-F FY2025: 'As of the date of this annual report, we have not adopted any share repurchase program'; only a board mandate authorizing up to 10% of shares exists, unexercised). The flat ADS count is therefore a pure modelling convention (full SBC expense is the charge for grant dilution), not a funded buyback.
inputs.fx_note: Model -> quote: 1 CNY = 0.15024 USD, i.e. USD/CNY 6.6562 (Yahoo CNY=X, 2026-11-18). Parity check: 9868.HK (HKEX, ordinary shares, no ADS conversion) HKD39.54 (2026-11-18) / USD-HKD 7.846 = US$5.08 per ordinary share x 2 ordinary shares/ADS = US$10.16 ADS-equivalent, versus the NYSE ADS price at inputs.price_as_of the same day -- a ~2.3% gap consistent with the HKEX/NYSE session-timing offset, which confirms both the FX direction and the 2:1 ADS ratio ('each ADS represents two Class A ordinary shares', 20-F FY2025). All per-ADS values are computed in RMB on an ADS-equivalent share count (ordinary shares / 2) and then multiplied by fx_rate; the unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in USD to match current_price.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' currency (CNY): China 10y CGB ~1.9% + beta 1.6 (small-cap, pre-scale, highly cyclical Chinese EV OEM -- meaningfully higher than a profitable large-cap China-tech comp's beta of ~1.2) x (mature-market ERP 5.5% + China country premium ~1.5% = 7.0%) = 1.9% + 11.2% = ~13.1%, rounded to 12.0% and held constant across all three scenarios per the house rule that cyclicality and execution risk already live in the probability-weighted flows and weights, not stacked again on the discount rate (no per-scenario WACC split).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. Operating lease liabilities (current+non-current, Sep 30 2026) are RMB2,291.8m and finance lease liabilities RMB4,702.6m, together ~6.8% of total_debt and <1% of FY0 revenue -- immaterial enough that no separate adjustment to EBITDA/D&A/capex is made beyond the default US GAAP ASC 842 treatment, under which operating-lease expense is already embedded in cost of revenue/opex and lease liabilities are excluded from net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Immaterial to FY2025 flows: 'net loss attributable to ordinary shareholders' equals total net loss in every disclosed period, i.e. no NCI profit/loss share existed through FY2025. A new RMB2,491.986m redeemable non-controlling interest appeared in mezzanine equity only as of Sep 30 2026 (absent at Dec 31 2025) and is deducted once, in equity_bridge, as a senior claim on consolidated equity rather than stripped from the flows (its earnings contribution is not yet material).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, 10-year horizon (owner-fcf.md section 2d: FY2025 EBITDA margin is barely positive/near-zero and still ramping quarter-to-quarter through 2026, so a 5-year Gordon capitalization would lock in an immature margin in perpetuity). XPEV is a dual-primary-listed (NYSE ADS + HKEX 9868.HK) Chinese EV OEM that generated positive owner FCF for the first time in FY2025 (RMB3,375.1m, 4.4% of revenue) after six years of losses funded substantially by external capital (2023 Volkswagen and DiDi share placements); the routing table's 'Operating company, non-US or cyclical' row applies, plus the adaptations file for (a) RMB flows against a USD ADS quote with a 2:1 ADS ratio, (b) immaterial leases under treatment B, and (c) a newly-appeared, still-immaterial redeemable NCI. NOT a mid-cycle FCF case: FY2025's owner FCF is the first positive print ever, not a mid-cycle average, so the historical revenue (42-67% CAGR) and equity (-2.5%/-6.3% CAGR, consumed by six years of accumulated losses) series are both unusable as forward anchors -- see historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning. The forward path is instead anchored to FY2026 Q4 guidance (169-174k deliveries, RMB30.4-31.8bn revenue, implying ~+14.9% FY2026 YoY) and the operating-margin trajectory already visible quarter to quarter in 2026 (-16.7% Q1 -> -5.8% Q2 -> -3.1% Q3 operating margin), decelerating revenue growth and ramping EBITDA margin toward a ~10% mature level (base case) over the component build (section 2).

bear.narrative: The China EV price war does not relent and XPeng's execution missteps repeat -- the August 2026 guidance cut that triggered a ~10% share-price decline is not a one-off. Growth decelerates faster than base, gross margin stays under renewed pressure, overseas volumes are capped by tariffs on Chinese-made EVs before European/Brazilian localized production comes online, and the VW relationship does not expand beyond its current scope. Robotaxi and robotics remain pre-commercial cost centers rather than profit contributors across the horizon. EBITDA margin reaches only ~6% at maturity, and continued early-year losses raise the prospect of further dilutive capital raises not modelled explicitly in the (flat) share count -- a qualitative risk on top of the lower valuation this path already implies.

base.narrative: XPeng continues the operating-leverage trajectory already visible quarter-to-quarter in 2026 (operating margin -16.7% Q1 -> -5.8% Q2 -> -3.1% Q3): revenue growth decelerates from the ~15% FY2026 guidance-implied rate as the China EV market matures, while MONA L05 and overseas volume (targeting >90k units and >20% of revenue from abroad in 2026, ~50% in five years) sustain double-digit growth through the mid-horizon. EBITDA margin scales toward a ~10% mature level on vehicle-mix improvement, VW technology-licensing leverage and manufacturing scale, without assuming the China EV price war meaningfully eases.

bull.narrative: Overseas expansion and the Volkswagen technology-licensing relationship both scale faster than guided -- overseas share approaches management's five-year ~50% aspiration sooner, VW's expanded E/E-architecture deal (now covering ICE and hybrid platforms, not just EVs) becomes a larger high-margin contributor, and robotaxi (L4 demonstration approval already granted in Guangzhou) and the Iron humanoid robot begin generating incremental high-margin revenue within the horizon. Gross margin holds or improves despite competition because of the AI/software mix shift, taking EBITDA margin to ~13% at maturity.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: House default is 15/50/35. Bear is moved up to 20% given the realized August-2026 guidance cut (execution risk is not hypothetical here) and the structural, multi-year China EV price war compressing margins industry-wide. Bull is moved down to 30% because the bull case needs overseas expansion, VW-licensing growth AND robotaxi/robotics monetization to each go right simultaneously within the horizon -- several independent things, not one. Base keeps the house-default 50% as the single most likely path given the already-visible 2026 operating-leverage inflection (op margin -16.7% -> -5.8% -> -3.1% over three quarters).

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
